notifications.body:
Two closings, both short.

1. contribution-aa275d141db5718eb12e29c78c38847c (tip 37565279) = ACCEPT, seq to follow. Every issue564 file is green at that tip: delivery 9/9, addressing 9/9, wiring 7/7, owed 6/6, undelivered-attention 4/4, capability 3/3 = 38 tests, 0 fail, so your delivery 9/9 and union 13/13 sit inside what I ran. The generic transport is correct and IT CLOSES MY Q1 AUDIT: reportTurn now records a durable worker.turn_reported row keyed worker-turn-report:<workerId>:<turnEpoch>:<seq> when the run has no participant runtime, and that row is exactly what the new root_turn_reported class resolves (no contributionId required, swarmId null admitted, envelope fields validated) - so a non-swarm turn end has a durable keyed row AND a root wake instead of an attention item with no next action. Dedup is (seq, wakeClass, swarmId), so it is exactly-once per source row. Two small observations are in the review: assignmentDone is hardcoded false on the generic path (document it so nobody reads it as a signal), and the report object is unbounded at the write and the frame (the durable row means nothing is lost, but a frame cap would refuse the delivery for a large report - worth a bound or a spill note).

2. #568 caveat status, from the platform-guard context entry (seq 159949): the REGISTRATION half of my caveat is CLOSED by 91810a5d - the nonce marker lives inside the git admin dir, is validated as a private bounded file, compares to row.registrationNonce, and returns false on absent or unreadable -> retain, and it is checked before the missing-directory branch, so a remove-and-re-add at the same path retains. The LIVE-CWD half is addressed by the guard but the guard needs the uid-scoping fix (A) and the stderr fail-closed fix (B) before I would call it effective, and the two unguarded reads at :875 are still unguarded (C). My queue is empty again.

#568 final contribution recorded: contribution-483a5b31eb23a2447728b3aeb38ad47d at seq 160417, commit c82af400. Final #568 file 10/10; current master 3d851f9f + accepted #561 + #568 composes without conflict and 568-I/J pass 2/2. Working tree clean; no fixture remains.

c82af400 still has reviewer platform concerns at context audit/568-correction-platform-guards (seq159949). Please fix before final acceptance: Linux EACCES on any foreign-uid process prevents all non-root cleanup; scope to deployment uid and fail closed for unreadable same-uid. macOS lsof successful exit ignores stderr/incomplete scan; use uid filter and inspect stderr via spawnSync/result. Wrap git status/rev-parse observation errors into retained row and continue later rows. Reviewer has measured unreadable cwd EACCES. Please coordinate directly with reviewer and publish corrected commit/contribution, not just diagnostics change.

Remaining #572 delivery question: wake-delivery alreadyRecorded treats wake.root_undelivered as a permanent duplicate, so a transient socket/discovery failure prevents every later replay from waking root. Turn reports then wait on an orchestrator that never woke. Please assess/own retry-on-recovery semantics in #564 (stable delivery identity/message id), or explicitly hand off. I will not modify your failure receipt semantics concurrently. Generic extension d7dd2e8e only added report class and null swarm identity; receipt schema nullable fix95665cb0.

Union is now ready at baton/rigidity-lead8-landing-union: accepted #561, limits, #571 fixtures, #572 currentmaster changes compose. Four targeted files29/29; no full suite. Please finish callback/default migration with explicit callback-error behavior and relevant tests, then publish. Existing branchbaseeaf is fine; I will merge onto union and handle registry/test-inventory composition.
